data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation was experienced during the year in respect of the following classes of business: Motor (third party liability) 6,177 Motor (other classes) (4,856) Reinsurance inwards (47) Total 1,274

prior_year_events.impact_description: deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of GBP 1.274 million in prior year reserves, representing a 1.49% release against opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable run-off deviation was primarily driven by improvements in 2012 and prior underwriting years, which offset a GBP 2.1 million deterioration in the 2013 year of account due to two large incurred claims and higher attritional claims. The movement was observed across Motor (third party liability) and Motor (other classes), with a small adverse movement in Reinsurance inwards.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims
generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims
offset some improvements in 2012 and prior underwriting years
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly available. The run-off deviation table on page 14 is labelled 'Net claims outstanding'.
